The structure of Nb10Te8O28 (reduced formula Nb5Te4O14) is monoclinic, space group C2/c (No. 15), with 46 atoms per unit cell across 7 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis gives Nb centers 5-coordinate oxygen environments, and O centers 3- or 4-coordinate mixed Nb/Te environments; Te centers are 4-coordinate to O. Polyhedron-sharing analysis identifies corner-sharing between 4-vertex O polyhedra and corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between 5-vertex Nb polyhedra. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single 3-periodic component spanning all 46 sites.
